server.name: io.github.askads/mcp-yandex-wordstat
server.description: MCP server for Yandex Wordstat API: top & related queries, demand dynamics and regions.
server.title: Yandex Wordstat MCP

environmentVariables.description: Yandex Cloud API key for the Search API (sent as Api-Key). Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Yandex Cloud folder id, injected into every request body.
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_FOLDER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Language for API responses (ru, en, ...).
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_LANG

environmentVariables.description: API root host override.
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429, 5xx, network).
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_MAX_RETRIES

server.name: io.github.askads/mcp-yandex-wordstat
server.description: MCP server for Yandex Wordstat API: top & related queries, demand dynamics and regions.
server.title: Yandex Wordstat

environmentVariables.description: Which Wordstat API to use: "cloud" (Yandex Cloud Search API v2, default) or "oauth" (api.wordstat.yandex.net).
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_FLAVOR

environmentVariables.description: Yandex Cloud API key (Search API). Required when WORDSTAT_FLAVOR=cloud. Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Yandex Cloud folder id, injected into every request. Required when WORDSTAT_FLAVOR=cloud.
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_FOLDER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Yandex OAuth token for api.wordstat.yandex.net. Required when WORDSTAT_FLAVOR=oauth. Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Language for API responses (ru, en, ...).
environmentVariables.name: WORDSTAT_LANG
